retrieve_tasks_predictions: retrieve ML predictions for a filtered queryset of tasks in a Label Studio project
delete_tasks: delete selected tasks from a Label Studio project and update project summary
delete_tasks_annotations: delete annotations and drafts for selected tasks, optionally filtered by annotator
delete_tasks_predictions: delete all predictions associated with a filtered queryset of tasks
delete_tasks_annotations_form: build an annotator selection form for filtering annotations to delete by specific annotators
